question: For the current boundary-touching fixed-square task, how much do signed body force, finite-face gap and structural response change when only the medium material multiplier is halved?
limitations: A two-value comparison measures sensitivity, not gamma convergence or a hard-contact limit.
The zero-right-margin boundary remains part of this task; gamma sensitivity does not exclude boundary influence or qualify transferable clamp force.
Gamma changes medium material coefficients only; re-equilibration also changes deformation and Hu. Force is not assumed proportional to gamma.
The small peak Hu Fy contribution does not prove alpha is unimportant.

independent_source_opinion.priority_difference: Peer gives right-padding priority when the immediate goal is transferable body force; gamma first remains acceptable for a low-change functional experiment restricted to the present boundary task.

matched_conditions: Same raw LF geometry, solid/support/passive masks, absolute coordinates, domain 80x40 mm and native h=1 mm; no optimization, smoothing or resampling.
Same fixed square side18 center(71,40), lower box[62,80]x[31,40], body overlay, merged fixed/free DOFs and top symmetry cut.
Same E=1 MPa, nu=.3, plane strain, t=20 mm, alpha=1e-6, Lr=80 mm and kr=.008615384615384613 MPa mm^2; only original-medium gamma/lam/mu entries may change.
Same normalized reference-arclength average input/output ports, zero output/input auxiliary springs, force scale Et=20 and signed half-model force convention.
Same 24 original ordered targets and peak1.2 mm, zero start, port_projection initialization, NumPy force/tangent implementation and Newton/Armijo/KKT/J/range/rollback gates.
Compare the same original_target_index and leg, using actual states only. New inserted bisection states, if any, receive their own fresh reference and are not interpolated into matched comparisons.
outputs: All actual path states: signed body total/material/Hu Fx,Fy; R_input; q_out; 2abs(Fy) and full mirrored net force reported separately.
Finite bottom/left/right tip distances, tip x/y, first normal rays, measured overlap/ambiguity diagnostics; gap differences in micrometres.
Medium minimum J and max absolute Hu; solid minimum J and all-solid Green extrema; same physical local-window extrema shown separately.
Load/unload matched common targets, force-gap curves, actual x1 shape/field/nodal-force views and complete unload return without clipping small forces to zero.
Actual force/tangent/LU counts, incomplete trial reasons, accepted N, wall time, RSS, and full fresh reference coverage.

subsequent_order: Review this gamma pair first; do not pre-run alpha, padding and grid as a batch.

Before generalizing clamp force, test right-medium padding while preserving mechanism/body absolute coordinates and physical port/support definitions, h=1, E/nu/t/gamma/alpha and especially Lr=80. Moving or shrinking the body is not a padding-only comparison.
Then choose alpha-only sensitivity if force/deformation evidence warrants it, keeping gamma fixed; alpha acts through global kr and is not another name for gamma.
Use a nested h=.5 refinement of the same cell-union geometry and physical ports/supports for a later discretization comparison; another LF fine design does not qualify as mesh convergence.
